name: nghttp2
build_command: cmake -S vendor/src/nghttp2 -B vendor/build/nghttp2-clang -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DENABLE_LIB_ONLY=ON -DBUILD_STATIC_LIBS=ON -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF -DBUILD_TESTING=OFF -DENABLE_WERROR=OFF && cmake --build vendor/build/nghttp2-clang -j$(nproc) && clang -std=c11 -D_POSIX_C_SOURCE=200809L -D_GNU_SOURCE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -pthread -Ivendor/src/nghttp2/lib/includes -Ivendor/build/nghttp2-clang/lib/includes vendor/build/nghttp2-clang/probe.c vendor/build/nghttp2-clang/lib/libnghttp2.a -o vendor/build/nghttp2-clang/probe
probe_log_tail:
ok: HPACK inflate consumes the block
ok: HPACK inflate emits the header
ok: HPACK inflate reports FINAL
probe_result: READY (0 failure(s))
probe exit: 0
notes: Static cmake build of the library only: ENABLE_LIB_ONLY=ON disables the nghttp/nghttpd/nghttpx/h2load applications, examples and HPACK tools (no separate proxy/server executable); BUILD_STATIC_LIBS=ON, BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF, BUILD_TESTING=OFF, ENABLE_WERROR=OFF (upstream default); no extra dependencies (no c-ares/libev needed in lib-only mode). Probe links libnghttp2.a directly and checks nghttp2_version(): version_str '1.70.0' and version_num 0x014600; creates and destroys a client session via nghttp2_session_callbacks_new + nghttp2_session_client_new; initializes the HPACK deflater (nghttp2_hd_deflate_new) and inflater (nghttp2_hd_inflate_new), then deflates ':method: GET' with nghttp2_hd_deflate_hd and inflates it back with nghttp2_hd_inflate_hd2 using the documented drain loop until NGHTTP2_HD_INFLATE_FINAL (with nghttp2_hd_inflate_end_headers), confirming the exact header round-trips. No upstream source was modified.
